# 单篇讲义生成任务

项目仓库: typst/typst
项目名: typst
讲义目录: typst-tutorial/
代码永久链接 base: https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/
当前 HEAD: 84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03
动作: new


---

## 项目学习路线（大纲方法论）

# 项目学习手册·大纲规划 Planner

## 角色

你是资深技术教育专家、源码阅读导师和项目学习路线设计者。

你运行在被分析项目的根目录内。

你可以使用：

- `Read`
- `Grep`
- `Glob`
- 只读 `git` 命令，例如 `git log`、`git diff`、`git show`、`git ls-files`

你不能：

- 修改源码
- 写入任何 `.md` 文件
- 输出 JSON 以外的文字

你的唯一产出是一个学习手册大纲 manifest JSON。

---

## 总目标

为当前项目规划一套「从零开始、由浅入深、结合源码和代码实践」的学习手册。

这套手册会被拆分成多篇 Markdown 讲义，后续 worker 会根据 manifest 逐篇生成。

每篇讲义应该满足：

1. 面向初学者也能读懂。
2. 只讲一个相对独立的主题。
3. 必须结合真实源码。
4. 必须包含一个可操作的代码实践任务。
5. 讲义之间有清晰依赖关系。

---

## 源码探查顺序

请按以下顺序理解项目，不要一开始就深入细节：

1. 项目说明
   - README
   - docs
   - examples
   - tutorials

2. 构建与运行方式
   - package.json
   - Cargo.toml
   - pyproject.toml
   - go.mod
   - pom.xml
   - Makefile
   - Dockerfile
   - CI 配置

3. 项目入口
   - CLI 入口
   - Web 服务入口
   - main 文件
   - library export 文件
   - examples 入口

4. 目录结构
   - src
   - lib
   - app
   - packages
   - crates
   - tests

5. 核心流程
   - 初始化流程
   - 配置加载
   - 请求/任务/数据处理主链路
   - 插件、扩展、调度、存储等核心机制

6. 测试与示例
   - 单元测试
   - 集成测试
   - benchmark
   - example usage

---

## 学习路线设计原则

请把学习手册设计成三层：

1. 入门层 beginner
   目标：让读者知道项目是什么、怎么运行、目录如何组织、核心入口在哪里。

2. 进阶层 intermediate
   目标：让读者理解主要模块、核心调用链、关键数据结构和配置机制。

3. 专家层 advanced
   目标：让读者理解扩展点、性能、并发、错误处理、测试、二次开发和架构取舍。

---

## 讲义拆分规则

- 每篇讲义只解决一个主要问题。
- 每篇讲义包含 2 到 5 个最小模块。
- 每篇讲义必须有一个 `practice_task`，描述读者要完成的代码实践。
- 每篇讲义的源码范围要适中，通常引用 1 到 6 个关键源码文件。
- 大型项目可以拆成 30 篇以上讲义；中型项目 15 到 30 篇；小型项目 8 到 15 篇。
- 不要为了数量硬拆，逻辑优先。
- 第一单元必须帮助读者从零开始，包括项目定位、运行方式、目录结构、入口文件。
- 后续单元再进入核心模块、源码机制、扩展实践。

---

## mode=full

首次生成大纲时：

1. 阅读项目关键文件。
2. 理解项目定位、技术栈、运行方式和核心模块。
3. 设计从零开始的学习路径。
4. 输出完整 manifest。
5. 所有讲义的 `action` 都必须是 `"new"`。

---

## mode=incremental

增量更新时：

1. 读取 stdin 中提供的现有 manifest。
2. 阅读项目中已有的 `<项目名>-tutorial/` 讲义目录，理解旧结构。
3. 使用：

   - `git diff previous_head..current_head`
   - `git log`
   - `git show`

   分析代码变化。

4. 输出更新后的完整 manifest。

每篇讲义的 `action` 按以下规则设置：

- `"keep"`
  代码变化不影响这篇讲义，无需重写。

- `"update"`
  小范围改动，例如函数重命名、参数调整、局部逻辑变化、链接行号变化。

- `"new"`
  新增功能、新增模块、新增重要机制，需要新增讲义。

- `"rebuild"`
  架构、主流程、公共接口、核心模型发生重大变化，旧讲义需要重建。

如果某篇旧讲义已经不再适合当前项目结构，可以从 manifest 中移除。

---

## manifest 输出格式

只输出严格 JSON，不要输出 Markdown，不要输出解释文字。

```json
{
  "project": "<项目名>",
  "head": "<current_head>",
  "rationale": "中文说明：为什么这样设计学习顺序、单元划分和讲义顺序。",
  "units": [
    {
      "id": "u1",
      "title": "单元标题",
      "level": "beginner",
      "order": 1,
      "lectures": [
        {
          "id": "u1-l1",
          "title": "讲义标题",
          "order": 1,
          "filename": "u1-l1-project-overview.md",
          "level": "beginner",
          "topic": "本讲义要讲什么，用 1 到 3 句中文说明。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "学习目标 1",
            "学习目标 2"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "README.md",
            "src/main.ts"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "模块 1",
            "模块 2"
          ],
          "practice_task": "本讲义对应的代码实践任务。",
          "depends_on": [],
          "action": "new"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## 字段要求

- `project`：项目名。
- `head`：当前 git HEAD。
- `rationale`：中文，一段即可。
- `unit.id`：格式为 `u1`、`u2`、`u3`。
- `lecture.id`：格式为 `u1-l1`、`u1-l2`。
- `filename`：
  - 必须全局唯一。
  - 必须小写。
  - 使用连字符。
  - 必须以 `.md` 结尾。
  - 文件位于 `<项目名>-tutorial/` 目录下。
- `level`：
  - `"beginner"`
  - `"intermediate"`
  - `"advanced"`
- `source_files`：
  - 只能填写你实际读过或确认存在的源码文件。
  - 不要编造文件路径。
- `depends_on`：
  - 使用讲义 id。
  - 没有依赖时填写空数组。
- `action`：
  - full 模式全部为 `"new"`。
  - incremental 模式使用 `"keep"`、`"update"`、`"new"`、`"rebuild"`。

---

## 重要约束

- 只基于真实源码和项目文件规划。
- 不确定的地方写 `"待确认"`。
- 不要编造不存在的模块、命令、接口或源码文件。
- 输出必须是合法 JSON。


## 完整大纲

```json
{
  "project": "typst",
  "rationale": "Typst 是一个由 17 个 Rust crate 组成的大型 Cargo workspace，编译器按「解析(typst-syntax) → 求值(typst-eval) → 内容实现(typst-realize) → 排版(typst-layout) → 导出(typst-pdf/typst-html/typst-render/typst-svg)」的流水线组织，而所有核心类型与 World/Engine 抽象集中在 typst-library，行为被拆分到各独立 crate（见 docs/dev/architecture.md 与各 lib.rs 文档注释）。因此学习路线设计为：第一单元从零开始，先让读者装好 CLI、用 Cargo 构建编译器、看清仓库与 crate 全景、跑通第一次编译并接触 tests/ 测试体系（cargo testit）；第二单元沿数据流进入语法层，依次讲 Source/FileId、Lexer、Parser/SyntaxNode、AST/Span 与增量重解析；第三单元进入 typst-library 与 typst-eval，讲 World、Library/全局作用域、Value、Content、Func/Args、解释器主循环和 Styles/set-show 数据模型；第四单元覆盖 realize、页面/flow/inline/grid/数学排版与 introspection 两遍编译；第五单元为专家层，讲 PDF/渲染/SVG 导出、Format 多目标注册机制、typst-bundle 新格式、proc-macro 体系、typst-ide 工具、typst-kit 字体与包生态、comemo 增量编译和 WASM 插件。讲义间用 depends_on 构成 DAG，每篇只讲一个主题并配一个可在本地仓库完成的代码实践任务，用 tests/ 套件或 CLI 输出验证结果。本次增量分析（64c5e8c0..84cca406a）显示变化高度集中在 typst-syntax：node.rs 大幅重构（replace_children/update_parent/renumber_children 迁移至 reparser.rs 的 InnerNode、numberize 改为 Option<&mut Span>、InnerNode 提升为 pub(super)）、reparser.rs 重写增量策略（try_reparse 更名 try_reparse_and_renumber、新增 MarkupReparse、根节点失败时仅重编号而非全量重解析、修复嵌套重解析、不再跨语法警告重解析）、Source::detached 被移除并新增 FileId::new_for_test 与 Source::new 接受 impl Into<String>；另有 location/stack/stroke 文档改进、divider 变为 Locatable、krilla/hayro 依赖升级与 typst-pdf 新增若干 a11y 校验错误分支。据此：u2-l3（SyntaxNode 树模型仍在但方法位置与签名变化）与 u2-l4（示例中的 Source::detached 已失效、span.rs Debug 输出变化）标记 update，u2-l5（核心机制被重写）标记 rebuild；其余已生成的 u1/u3/u4-l1..l3 讲义内容不受影响标记 keep；u2-l1 与 u4-l4 之后及第五单元讲义尚未生成，保持 new，生成时按新代码（如 FileId::new_for_test）撰写。",

## 前置讲义摘要（你必须基于这些已建立的认知继续，不要重复，要承接）

### u1-l1 Typst 是什么：项目定位与语言初印象

文件尾部已完整读齐（与此前收到的片段一致，无新增内容），摘要维持不变，即上一条输出：

本讲精读仓库 README 与 docs 说明，建立项目全景：Typst 是基于标记的排版系统，目标是与 LaTeX 同样强大但更易学好用，仓库本体为编译器与 CLI。六大卖点：内置标记、灵活函数、集成脚本、数学与文献管理、增量编译、友好报错。引入的关键概念：标记语言、crate、set/show 规则、# 脚本、数学模式、compile/watch 命令及输出格式按扩展名推断；三条设计原则为一致性、可组合、增量。docs 目录是官方文档站源码工程，教程与参考内容是初学者资料入口，可由 cargo docit 本地构建。下一讲转向 Cargo workspace 与从源码构建编译器。
### u1-l2 从源码构建：Cargo workspace 与构建命令

本讲把 Typst 仓库当作一个 Rust 工程从源码构建，引入 crate、workspace、集中依赖表、profile、cargo 别名等术语。核心结论：根 Cargo.toml 是 workspace 清单而非包清单，members 纳入 17 个编译器 crate 及 docs、tests 包，default-members 指向 typst-cli，故根目录裸跑 cargo 默认只构建 CLI；共享元数据（版本 0.15.1、MSRV 1.92、edition 2024）集中声明，成员以 workspace = true 继承。依赖分三种来源：path（仓库内部 crate）、git（typst-assets、typst-dev-assets 等锁定 rev，保证可复现，首次构建需联网）、registry（crates.io）。profile 分三档：dev（依赖强制 opt-level 2）、dev-fast、release。cargo testit 与 docit 是 .cargo/config.toml 中的普通别名，分别运行 test-wrapper 集成测试与 typst-docs 文档站。常用命令为 cargo build -p typst-cli、cargo run -p typst-cli -- compile、cargo test。本讲打通克隆—构建—运行闭环，为下一讲 crate 分工全景铺路。
### u1-l3 仓库全景：17 个 crate 的分工地图

本讲梳理 Typst 仓库 17 个 crate 的分工：编译按解析→求值→realize→排版→导出五段流水线推进，数据形态依次为字符串→SyntaxNode→Content→Frame→输出字节。依赖自下而上分层：底层工具、typst-syntax、类型地基 typst-library、各阶段与导出 crate、总装 typst、应用 cli/ide/kit。核心决策「类型定义在 typst-library、行为拆到各阶段 crate」由 Routines 函数指针表落实：签名住在 library、实现在总装 crate 的 ROUTINES 表接线，形同动态链接，避免循环依赖。compile 只求值一次，循环的是排版与内省至收敛；导出器仅是总装的 dev-dependency，由使用者接线；架构文档可能滞后，以源码为准。
### u1-l4 CLI 入口：从命令行到一次编译的调用链

本讲读 typst-cli 的三个文件，追踪从命令行到一次编译的调用链。main.rs 是刻意做薄的入口：子命令各对应一个同名模块文件，全局 ARGS 用 LazyLock 惰性解析一次，dispatch 以 match 分发，退出码经线程局部变量 EXIT 中转。args.rs 用 clap 派生宏实现「数据结构即接口」：compile 与 watch 借 flatten 共享 CompileArgs，Input/Output 枚举把 stdin/stdout 与文件路径统一进类型。compile.rs 的主干是先由 CompileConfig（按 --format、输出扩展名、默认 PDF 之序推断格式与输出路径）与 SystemWorld 备好环境，再执行 compile_once：compile_and_export 调 typst::compile::<T>，以泛型参数区分产出物类型（分页文档、HTML、Bundle），导出统一收敛到 Output::write。compile_once 是被 compile 与 watch 复用的单次编译单元；SystemWorld 的实现细节留待下一讲。
### u1-l5 测试体系入门：cargo testit 与 tests/ 目录

# 项目学习手册·大纲规划 Planner

## 角色

你是资深技术教育专家、源码阅读导师和项目学习路线设计者。

你运行在被分析项目的根目录内。

你可以使用：

- `Read`
- `Grep`
- `Glob`
- 只读 `git` 命令，例如 `git log`、`git diff`、`git show`、`git ls-files`

你不能：

- 修改源码
- 写入任何 `.md` 文件
- 输出 JSON 以外的文字

你的唯一产出是一个学习手册大纲 manifest JSON。

---

## 总目标

为当前项目规划一套「从零开始、由浅入深、结合源码和代码实践」的学习手册。

这套手册会被拆分成多篇 Markdown 讲义，后续 worker 会根据 manifest 逐篇生成。

每篇讲义应该满足：

1. 面向初学者也能读懂。
2. 只讲一个相对独立的主题。
3. 必须结合真实源码。
4. 必须包含一个可操作的代码实践任务。
5. 讲义之间有清晰依赖关系。

---

## 源码探查顺序

请按以下顺序理解项目，不要一开始就深入细节：

1. 项目说明
   - README
   - docs
   - examples
   - tutorials

2. 构建与运行方式
   - package.json
   - Cargo.toml
   - pyproject.toml
   - go.mod
   - pom.xml
   - Makefile
   - Dockerfile
   - CI 配置

3. 项目入口
   - CLI 入口
   - Web 服务入口
   - main 文件
   - library export 文件
   - examples 入口

4. 目录结构
   - src
   - lib
   - app
   - packages
   - crates
   - tests

5. 核心流程
   - 初始化流程
   - 配置加载
   - 请求/任务/数据处理主链路
   - 插件、扩展、调度、存储等核心机制

6. 测试与示例
   - 单元测试
   - 集成测试
   - benchmark
   - example usage

---

## 学习路线设计原则

请把学习手册设计成三层：

1. 入门层 beginner
   目标：让读者知道项目是什么、怎么运行、目录如何组织、核心入口在哪里。

2. 进阶层 intermediate
   目标：让读者理解主要模块、核心调用链、关键数据结构和配置机制。

3. 专家层 advanced
   目标：让读者理解扩展点、性能、并发、错误处理、测试、二次开发和架构取舍。

---

## 讲义拆分规则

- 每篇讲义只解决一个主要问题。
- 每篇讲义包含 2 到 5 个最小模块。
- 每篇讲义必须有一个 `practice_task`，描述读者要完成的代码实践。
- 每篇讲义的源码范围要适中，通常引用 1 到 6 个关键源码文件。
- 大型项目可以拆成 30 篇以上讲义；中型项目 15 到 30 篇；小型项目 8 到 15 篇。
- 不要为了数量硬拆，逻辑优先。
- 第一单元必须帮助读者从零开始，包括项目定位、运行方式、目录结构、入口文件。
- 后续单元再进入核心模块、源码机制、扩展实践。

---

## mode=full

首次生成大纲时：

1. 阅读项目关键文件。
2. 理解项目定位、技术栈、运行方式和核心模块。
3. 设计从零开始的学习路径。
4. 输出完整 manifest。
5. 所有讲义的 `action` 都必须是 `"new"`。

---

## mode=incremental

增量更新时：

1. 读取 stdin 中提供的现有 manifest。
2. 阅读项目中已有的 `<项目名>-tutorial/` 讲义目录，理解旧结构。
3. 使用：

   - `git diff previous_head..current_head`
   - `git log`
   - `git show`

   分析代码变化。

4. 输出更新后的完整 manifest。

每篇讲义的 `action` 按以下规则设置：

- `"keep"`
  代码变化不影响这篇讲义，无需重写。

- `"update"`
  小范围改动，例如函数重命名、参数调整、局部逻辑变化、链接行号变化。

- `"new"`
  新增功能、新增模块、新增重要机制，需要新增讲义。

- `"rebuild"`
  架构、主流程、公共接口、核心模型发生重大变化，旧讲义需要重建。

如果某篇旧讲义已经不再适合当前项目结构，可以从 manifest 中移除。

---

## manifest 输出格式

只输出严格 JSON，不要输出 Markdown，不要输出解释文字。

  "project": "<项目名>",

---

## 字段要求

- `project`：项目名。
- `head`：当前 git HEAD。
- `rationale`：中文，一段即可。
- `unit.id`：格式为 `u1`、`u2`、`u3`。
- `lecture.id`：格式为 `u1-l1`、`u1-l2`。
- `filename`：
  - 必须全局唯一。
  - 必须小写。
  - 使用连字符。
  - 必须以 `.md` 结尾。
  - 文件位于 `<项目名>-tutorial/` 目录下。
- `level`：
  - `"beginner"`
  - `"intermediate"`
  - `"advanced"`
- `source_files`：
  - 只能填写你实际读过或确认存在的源码文件。
  - 不要编造文件路径。
- `depends_on`：
  - 使用讲义 id。
  - 没有依赖时填写空数组。
- `action`：
  - full 模式全部为 `"new"`。
  - incremental 模式使用 `"keep"`、`"update"`、`"new"`、`"rebuild"`。

---

## 重要约束

- 只基于真实源码和项目文件规划。
- 不确定的地方写 `"待确认"`。
- 不要编造不存在的模块、命令、接口或源码文件。
- 输出必须是合法 JSON。

## 前置讲义摘要（你必须基于这些已建立的认知继续，不要重复，要承接）

### u1-l1 Typst 是什么：项目定位与语言初印象

文件尾部已完整读齐（与此前收到的片段一致，无新增内容），摘要维持不变，即上一条输出：

本讲精读仓库 README 与 docs 说明，建立项目全景：Typst 是基于标记的排版系统，目标是与 LaTeX 同样强大但更易学好用，仓库本体为编译器与 CLI。六大卖点：内置标记、灵活函数、集成脚本、数学与文献管理、增量编译、友好报错。引入的关键概念：标记语言、crate、set/show 规则、# 脚本、数学模式、compile/watch 命令及输出格式按扩展名推断；三条设计原则为一致性、可组合、增量。docs 目录是官方文档站源码工程，教程与参考内容是初学者资料入口，可由 cargo docit 本地构建。下一讲转向 Cargo workspace 与从源码构建编译器。
### u1-l2 从源码构建：Cargo workspace 与构建命令

本讲把 Typst 仓库当作一个 Rust 工程从源码构建，引入 crate、workspace、集中依赖表、profile、cargo 别名等术语。核心结论：根 Cargo.toml 是 workspace 清单而非包清单，members 纳入 17 个编译器 crate 及 docs、tests 包，default-members 指向 typst-cli，故根目录裸跑 cargo 默认只构建 CLI；共享元数据（版本 0.15.1、MSRV 1.92、edition 2024）集中声明，成员以 workspace = true 继承。依赖分三种来源：path（仓库内部 crate）、git（typst-assets、typst-dev-assets 等锁定 rev，保证可复现，首次构建需联网）、registry（crates.io）。profile 分三档：dev（依赖强制 opt-level 2）、dev-fast、release。cargo testit 与 docit 是 .cargo/config.toml 中的普通别名，分别运行 test-wrapper 集成测试与 typst-docs 文档站。常用命令为 cargo build -p typst-cli、cargo run -p typst-cli -- compile、cargo test。本讲打通克隆—构建—运行闭环，为下一讲 crate 分工全景铺路。
### u1-l3 仓库全景：17 个 crate 的分工地图

本讲解析页面内部的块级流式布局。核心是 region 模型：`Regions` 以剩余高度（size）、完整基准（full）与后续区域队列（backlog/last）刻画「带未来的剩余空间」，页面流经 `Regions::repeat` 得到无限翻页序列。flow 主循环分 collect（预处理、段落提前断行）、compose（组装单页）、distribute（逐 Child 分配）三层，`Work` 跨层携带未完成工作；分配三原则为放得下就放、may_progress 为真才换页、换页无意义则硬放溢出，辅以 spill 余料续排、sticky 迁移与 widow/orphan 保护。容器本质是区域变换：block 用 breakable_pod 继承或切分区域序列，pad 成对 shrink/grow，stack 关闭子内容主轴 expand；stack、pad 等经内置规则包装为带 MultiLayouter 回调的 BlockElem，构造 pod 后递归 layout_fragment，天然复用 flow 的全部协商机制。
### u4-l5 行内排版：inline 与文本整形

本讲解析 Typst 行内排版引擎（typst-layout/src/inline）：段落经 collect、prepare、linebreak、finalize 四阶段流水线变成多行 Frame。collect 把文本、间距、盒子、内联公式、标签拍平成一条全文 String 与统一的 Item/Segment 序列，非文本物以 U+FFFC 占位，SpanMapper 反查源码位置；prepare 做 BiDi 分析并按方向与文字系统切 run，用 rustybuzz 整形，FontBook 的 select/select_fallback 完成字体选择与 tofu 递归回退；linebreak 借 ICU4X 断行器（中日文换用定制 CJ 断行器）与 hypher 连字典枚举候选，按 Simple 贪心或 Knuth-Plass 全局最优选点，只量宽不建帧；finalize 逐行 commit：BiDi 重排、CJK-拉丁间距与行首尾标点压缩、两步 justify、Fractional 延迟布局、条目按逻辑序排列。段落得以在 flow 的 collect 阶段提前断行，因断行仅依赖行宽。关键术语：整形、字形、簇、ShapedText、InlineElem、UAX #14。

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

run_in_background.description: Agents run in the background by default; you will be notified when one completes. Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

isolation.description: Isolation mode. "worktree" creates a temporary git worktree so the agent works on an isolated copy of the repo. "remote" launches the agent in a remote cloud environment (always runs in background; availability is gated).

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

# 项目学习手册·大纲规划 Planner

## 角色

你是资深技术教育专家、源码阅读导师和项目学习路线设计者。

你运行在被分析项目的根目录内。

你可以使用：

- `Read`
- `Grep`
- `Glob`
- 只读 `git` 命令，例如 `git log`、`git diff`、`git show`、`git ls-files`

你不能：

- 修改源码
- 写入任何 `.md` 文件
- 输出 JSON 以外的文字

你的唯一产出是一个学习手册大纲 manifest JSON。

---

## 总目标

为当前项目规划一套「从零开始、由浅入深、结合源码和代码实践」的学习手册。

这套手册会被拆分成多篇 Markdown 讲义，后续 worker 会根据 manifest 逐篇生成。

每篇讲义应该满足：

1. 面向初学者也能读懂。
2. 只讲一个相对独立的主题。
3. 必须结合真实源码。
4. 必须包含一个可操作的代码实践任务。
5. 讲义之间有清晰依赖关系。

---

## 源码探查顺序

请按以下顺序理解项目，不要一开始就深入细节：

1. 项目说明
   - README
   - docs
   - examples
   - tutorials

   - package.json
   - Cargo.toml
   - pyproject.toml
   - go.mod
   - pom.xml
   - Makefile
   - Dockerfile
   - CI 配置

   - Web 服务入口

   - library export 文件
   - examples 入口

4. 目录结构
   - src
   - lib

5. 核心流程

## 学习路线设计原则

请把学习手册设计成三层：

1. 入门层 beginner
   目标：让读者知道项目是什么、怎么运行、目录如何组织、核心入口在哪里。

2. 进阶层 intermediate
   目标：让读者理解主要模块、核心调用链、关键数据结构和配置机制。

3. 专家层 advanced
   目标：让读者理解扩展点、性能、并发、错误处理、测试、二次开发和架构取舍。

- 每篇讲义只解决一个主要问题。
- 每篇讲义包含 2 到 5 个最小模块。
- 每篇讲义必须有一个 `practice_task`，描述读者要完成的代码实践。
- 每篇讲义的源码范围要适中，通常引用 1 到 6 个关键源码文件。
- 大型项目可以拆成 30 篇以上讲义；中型项目 15 到 30 篇；小型项目 8 到 15 篇。
- 不要为了数量硬拆，逻辑优先。
- 第一单元必须帮助读者从零开始，包括项目定位、运行方式、目录结构、入口文件。
- 后续单元再进入核心模块、源码机制、扩展实践。

---

## mode=full

首次生成大纲时：

1. 阅读项目关键文件。
2. 理解项目定位、技术栈、运行方式和核心模块。
3. 设计从零开始的学习路径。
4. 输出完整 manifest。
5. 所有讲义的 `action` 都必须是 `"new"`。

---

## mode=incremental

增量更新时：

1. 读取 stdin 中提供的现有 manifest。
2. 阅读项目中已有的 `<项目名>-tutorial/` 讲义目录，理解旧结构。
3. 使用：

   - `git diff previous_head..current_head`
   - `git log`
   - `git show`

   分析代码变化。

4. 输出更新后的完整 manifest。

每篇讲义的 `action` 按以下规则设置：

- `"keep"`
  代码变化不影响这篇讲义，无需重写。

- `"update"`
  小范围改动，例如函数重命名、参数调整、局部逻辑变化、链接行号变化。

- `"new"`
  新增功能、新增模块、新增重要机制，需要新增讲义。

- `"rebuild"`
  架构、主流程、公共接口、核心模型发生重大变化，旧讲义需要重建。

如果某篇旧讲义已经不再适合当前项目结构，可以从 manifest 中移除。

---

## manifest 输出格式

只输出严格 JSON，不要输出 Markdown，不要输出解释文字。

```json
{
  "project": "<项目名>",
  "head": "<current_head>",
  "rationale": "中文说明：为什么这样设计学习顺序、单元划分和讲义顺序。",
  "units": [
    {
      "id": "u1",
      "title": "单元标题",
      "level": "beginner",
      "order": 1,
      "lectures": [
        {
          "id": "u1-l1",
          "title": "讲义标题",
          "order": 1,
          "filename": "u1-l1-project-overview.md",
          "level": "beginner",
          "topic": "本讲义要讲什么，用 1 到 3 句中文说明。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "学习目标 1",
            "学习目标 2"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "README.md",
            "src/main.ts"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "模块 1",
            "模块 2"
          ],
          "practice_task": "本讲义对应的代码实践任务。",
          "depends_on": [],
          "action": "new"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## 字段要求

- `project`：项目名。
- `head`：当前 git HEAD。
- `rationale`：中文，一段即可。
- `unit.id`：格式为 `u1`、`u2`、`u3`。
- `lecture.id`：格式为 `u1-l1`、`u1-l2`。
- `filename`：
  - 必须全局唯一。
  - 必须小写。
  - 使用连字符。
  - 必须以 `.md` 结尾。
  - 文件位于 `<项目名>-tutorial/` 目录下。
- `level`：
  - `"beginner"`
  - `"intermediate"`
  - `"advanced"`
- `source_files`：
  - 只能填写你实际读过或确认存在的源码文件。
  - 不要编造文件路径。
- `depends_on`：
  - 使用讲义 id。
  - 没有依赖时填写空数组。
- `action`：
  - full 模式全部为 `"new"`。
  - incremental 模式使用 `"keep"`、`"update"`、`"new"`、`"rebuild"`。

---

## 重要约束

- 只基于真实源码和项目文件规划。
- 不确定的地方写 `"待确认"`。
- 不要编造不存在的模块、命令、接口或源码文件。
- 输出必须是合法 JSON。

### u1-l1 Typst 是什么：项目定位与语言初印象

文件尾部已完整读齐（与此前收到的片段一致，无新增内容），摘要维持不变，即上一条输出：

本讲精读仓库 README 与 docs 说明，建立项目全景：Typst 是基于标记的排版系统，目标是与 LaTeX 同样强大但更易学好用，仓库本体为编译器与 CLI。六大卖点：内置标记、灵活函数、集成脚本、数学与文献管理、增量编译、友好报错。引入的关键概念：标记语言、crate、set/show 规则、# 脚本、数学模式、compile/watch 命令及输出格式按扩展名推断；三条设计原则为一致性、可组合、增量。docs 目录是官方文档站源码工程，教程与参考内容是初学者资料入口，可由 cargo docit 本地构建。下一讲转向 Cargo workspace 与从源码构建编译器。
### u1-l2 从源码构建：Cargo workspace 与构建命令

本讲把 Typst 仓库当作一个 Rust 工程从源码构建，引入 crate、workspace、集中依赖表、profile、cargo 别名等术语。核心结论：根 Cargo.toml 是 workspace 清单而非包清单，members 纳入 17 个编译器 crate 及 docs、tests 包，default-members 指向 typst-cli，故根目录裸跑 cargo 默认只构建 CLI；共享元数据（版本 0.15.1、MSRV 1.92、edition 2024）集中声明，成员以 workspace = true 继承。依赖分三种来源：path（仓库内部 crate）、git（typst-assets、typst-dev-assets 等锁定 rev，保证可复现，首次构建需联网）、registry（crates.io）。profile 分三档：dev（依赖强制 opt-level 2）、dev-fast、release。cargo testit 与 docit 是 .cargo/config.toml 中的普通别名，分别运行 test-wrapper 集成测试与 typst-docs 文档站。常用命令为 cargo build -p typst-cli、cargo run -p typst-cli -- compile、cargo test。本讲打通克隆—构建—运行闭环，为下一讲 crate 分工全景铺路。
### u1-l3 仓库全景：17 个 crate 的分工地图

本讲梳理 Typst 仓库 17 个 crate 的分工：编译按解析→求值→realize→排版→导出五段流水线推进，数据形态依次为字符串→SyntaxNode→Content→Frame→输出字节。依赖自下而上分层：底层工具、typst-syntax、类型地基 typst-library、各阶段与导出 crate、总装 typst、应用 cli/ide/kit。核心决策「类型定义在 typst-library、行为拆到各阶段 crate」由 Routines 函数指针表落实：签名住在 library、实现在总装 crate 的 ROUTINES 表接线，形同动态链接，避免循环依赖。compile 只求值一次，循环的是排版与内省至收敛；导出器仅是总装的 dev-dependency，由使用者接线；架构文档可能滞后，以源码为准。
### u1-l4 CLI 入口：从命令行到一次编译的调用链

本讲读 typst-cli 的三个文件，追踪从命令行到一次编译的调用链。main.rs 是刻意做薄的入口：子命令各对应一个同名模块文件，全局 ARGS 用 LazyLock 惰性解析一次，dispatch 以 match 分发，退出码经线程局部变量 EXIT 中转。args.rs 用 clap 派生宏实现「数据结构即接口」：compile 与 watch 借 flatten 共享 CompileArgs，Input/Output 枚举把 stdin/stdout 与文件路径统一进类型。compile.rs 的主干是先由 CompileConfig（按 --format、输出扩展名、默认 PDF 之序推断格式与输出路径）与 SystemWorld 备好环境，再执行 compile_once：compile_and_export 调 typst::compile::<T>，以泛型参数区分产出物类型（分页文档、HTML、Bundle），导出统一收敛到 Output::write。compile_once 是被 compile 与 watch 复用的单次编译单元；SystemWorld 的实现细节留待下一讲。
### u1-l5 测试体系入门：cargo testit 与 tests/ 目录

本讲介绍 Typst 的集成测试体系。tests/ 分四层：src 存运行器代码，suite 存 .typ 输入，ref 存期望输出，store 存活输出与报告（不入库）。cargo testit 是别名，经 test-wrapper 转发为 cargo test --workspace --test=tests；测试包设 harness=false、使用自定义运行器，支持名字正则与 -p 路径过滤、--exact 精确匹配、--stages 裁剪环节、--list 与 --update 更新引用。套件用「--- 名字 属性+ ---」分节，测试分三类：断言型（运行器注入的 #test）、诊断型（// Error 等注解）、视觉对照型（与参考图比对）。stage 构成树：eval→paged→render/pdf→pdftags/svg，另有 html 与实验性 bundle，蕴含与前置规则决定实际执行集。引用分两种：render/bundle 用文件引用（≤20 KiB），pdf/svg/html/pdftags 用 hashes.txt 哈希引用；失败生成 store/report.html，缺旧活输出时 regen 可在旧 revision 重跑补齐。核心结论：README 属性列表滞后（如 pdfstandard 已不在代码中），以 collect.rs::parse_attrs 为准。
### u2-l1 源码与文件身份：Source、FileId 与包路径

本讲覆盖 typst-syntax 的三个模块：Source 与 Lines 的源码快照、Span 与 DiagSpan 的位置表示、FileId 与包路径的文件身份。Source 是文本、行表、语法树的不可变快照，包在 Arc<LazyHash> 中令克隆与哈希近乎零成本，服务记忆化编译；edit 走写时复制与增量重解析；Lines 负责行列与字节的双向换算，列按字符计数。Span 为 8 字节：高 16 位 FileId，低 48 位编号，分 Detached、节点编号、区间等形态，经 SpanKind 与 DiagSpanKind 解包；以节点编号替代字节区间，使编号在编辑后基本稳定、保住缓存命中，DiagSpan 以 extra 补存区间终点或 SubRange。FileId 是驻留 RootedPath（VirtualRoot 为 Project 或 Package，加规范化的 VirtualPath）所得的 2 字节句柄：new 去重复用，unique 不复用，new_for_test 供测试；VirtualPath 的构造不变量把路径词法锁死在根内。包身份另由 PackageSpec 与 PackageManifest 定义。

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. run_in_background.description: Agents run in the background by default; you will be notified when one completes. isolation.description: Isolation mode. "worktree" creates a temporary git worktree so the agent works on an isolated copy of the repo. "remote" launches the agent in a remote cloud environment (always runs in background; availability is gated).

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

531	    fn try_from(value: Content) -> HintedStrResult<Self> {
532	        if value.is::<GridHeader>() {

534	        }
535	        if value.is::<TableHeader>() {
536	            bail!("cannot place a table header within another header or footer");
537	        }
538	        if value.is::<GridFooter>() {
539	            bail!("cannot place a grid footer within another footer or header");
540	        }
541	        if value.is::<TableFooter>() {

543	        }

559	                hint: "use `grid.vline` instead";
560	            );
561	        }

563	        Ok(value

566	            .or_else(|value| value.into_packed::<GridVLine>().map(Self::VLine))
567	            .or_else(|value| value.into_packed::<GridCell>().map(Self::Cell))
568	            .unwrap_or_else(|value| {

# 流式布局：flow、regions 与分页

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 解释 **region（区域）** 的「剩余空间」模型：`Regions` 结构的五个字段各管什么、区域如何被内容逐渐消耗、何时判定「满了」、如何切换到下一个区域。
2. 跟踪一个段落块从 `layout_fragment` 进入 flow 主循环、经 collect 预处理、由 distribute 分配进区域、最终产出 `Frame` 的完整路径。
3. 理解 `stack`、`pad` 等容器如何**变换**区域（缩小、分摊、关闭扩展），并通过同一条 flow 机制递归复用。

本讲是第四单元「排版管线」的核心一讲：上一讲（u4-l3）我们看到了页面如何被创建、`layout_document` 如何收集 `Page`；本讲钻进页面的**内部**，看内容是怎样一格一格填进页面剩余空间的。

## 2. 前置知识

- **块级与行内**：块级内容（段落、标题、块）像积木一样从上往下堆叠；行内内容（文字、加粗）在行内从左往右流动。本讲的 flow 负责**块级**方向。
- **`Frame` 与 `Fragment`**（u4-l2、u4-l3 已讲）：`Frame` 是一个绝对定位的二维绘图树（最终排版产物）；`Fragment` 是一组 `Frame`——因为内容可能跨页/跨区域，一个逻辑内容会产出多个帧。
- **`Abs` 与 `Rel`**：`Abs` 是绝对长度（内部单位为 pt）；`Rel<Abs>` 是「相对长度 = 比例 × 基准 + 绝对部分」，需要相对某个基准尺寸解析。
- **pod**：Typst 源码术语，指「给子内容的区域」（pod regions）。容器不会直接把自己的区域交给子内容，而是先按自身规则构造一个缩小的/变换过的 pod。
- **溢出（overflow）**：内容超出区域边界。Typst 的排版永不失败，放不下时宁可溢出也不死循环——这句话的机制正是本讲 4.3 的主题。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `crates/typst-library/src/layout/regions.rs` | `Region` / `Regions` 的定义：区域的数据模型与推进逻辑（类型在 typst-library，行为在 typst-layout——正是 u1-l3 讲过的架构决策） |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/flow/mod.rs` | flow 模块入口：`layout_frame` / `layout_fragment` / `layout_columns` 与主循环 `layout_flow` |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/flow/collect.rs` | collect 阶段：把 realize 输出的元素对预处理成 `Child` 枚举（段落在此提前断行） |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/flow/compose.rs` | compose 阶段：组装单个页面/区域（列、浮动体、脚注、行号），调用 distribute |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/flow/distribute.rs` | distribute 阶段：把 `Child` 逐个分配进区域，决定「放下还是换页」 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/flow/block.rs` | `BlockElem` 的可断/不可断布局，以及 pod 构造（`unbreakable_pod` / `breakable_pod`） |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/stack.rs` | `#stack()` 的布局器：一个精简的「自管区域」示范 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/pad.rs` | `#pad()` 的布局器：区域缩放（shrink/grow）的教科书案例 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/pages/run.rs` | 页面运行：flow 与页面的衔接点（`Regions::repeat` 的诞生地） |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/rules.rs` | 内置规则注册：`PAD_RULE` / `STACK_RULE` / `COLUMNS_RULE` 如何把容器接入 flow |

                                              stack.rs / pad.rs / grid.rs …

# 网格世界：grid、table、列表与数学布局

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 解释 **轨道（track）** 的数据模型：`Sizing` 的三种形态（`auto` / 固定或相对长度 / `fr`）如何在 `CellGrid` 中统一成带 gutter 的轨道序列，`table` 为什么和 `grid` 共用同一台布局引擎。
2. 讲清 **轨道尺寸协商** 的完整顺序：固定轨道先解析 → `auto` 轨道用试探布局测量 → 剩余空间按比例分给 `fr` 轨道（或空间不足时让 `auto` 轨道「公平收缩」），并能手工推算一张表格的列宽。
3. 描述 `lists.rs` 列表布局的 **架构演进**：它曾经真的复用网格引擎（`CellGrid` + `GridLayouter`），2026 年 5 月起改为专用的 `ListLayouter` + 栈布局，理解这次替换背后的动机（基线对齐）。
4. 了解数学排版如何组织 **符号行与嵌套结构**：`MathItem` 中间表示 → `MathFragment` 片段流 → `MathRun` 行装配，以及分数与根式如何用字体 MATH 表常量逐块拼装并对齐基线。

本讲是第四单元「排版管线」的倒数第二讲：u4-l4 讲了 flow 如何把块级内容分配进 region，u4-l5 讲了行内断行；本讲看两个「二维」的特化布局器——网格与数学公式，它们都建立在前面的 region 协商机制之上。

## 2. 前置知识

- **`Abs` / `Rel` / `Fr`**：`Abs` 是绝对长度（pt）；`Rel` 是「比例 × 基准 + 绝对部分」（如 `20% - 1cm`），要相对某个基准解析；`Fr` 是「剩余空间的分数」（fractional），永远最后参与分配。
- **`Region` / `Regions`**（u4-l4）：给子内容的「可用空间提案」。网格在测量 auto 列时，会给每个单元格发一个试探性的 pod region，让它先排一遍以获知自然宽度——这是本讲反复出现的模式。
- **`Frame` / `Fragment`**：`Frame` 是绝对定位的二维绘图树，且带**基线（baseline）**概念；`Fragment` 是一组 `Frame`（内容可能跨页）。
- **Synthesize 阶段**（u4-l2）：realize 之前，元素有机会把脚本参数「整理」成内部字段。`GridElem`/`TableElem` 正是在这里把用户输入编译成 `CellGrid`。
- **内置规则注册**（u4-l2）：`GRID_RULE`、`TABLE_RULE` 等常量经 `NativeRuleMap` 装配进 `Library`，把元素接线到具体布局函数。
- **试探布局（measure）**：先用一个假想的 region 布局一次、只取尺寸丢弃正式产物的做法。行内断行（u4-l5）里已经见过，网格测量 auto 列、列表测量 marker 都靠它。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `crates/typst-library/src/layout/container.rs` | `Sizing` 枚举：轨道尺寸的三种形态（类型在 library，行为在 layout——u1-l3 的架构决策又一例） |

| `crates/typst-library/src/model/table.rs` | `TableElem` 的 Synthesize：`table` 与 `grid` 在这一层汇合 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/grid/mod.rs` | 布局侧入口：`layout_grid` / `layout_table` / `layout_cell` |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs` | `GridLayouter`：轨道尺寸协商（`measure_columns` 一族）与逐行布局主循环 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/lists.rs` | 列表/枚举布局：`ListLayouter` 测量与 `ItemLayouter` 基线对齐（本讲讲它的「前世今生」） |

| `crates/typst-layout/src/math/mod.rs` | 数学布局入口 `layout_equation_inline` / `layout_equation_block` 与 `MathContext` |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/math/run.rs` | `MathRun` / `stack_rows`：符号行装配、对齐点、行内断行机会 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/math/fraction.rs` | 分数布局：MATH 表常量驱动的拼装 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/math/radical.rs` | 根式布局：拉伸根号、指数抬升 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/math/table.rs` | 矩阵/向量布局：数学世界里的「小网格」 |
| `crates/typst-layout/src/rules.rs` | 内置规则：`GRID_RULE` / `TABLE_RULE` / `LIST_RULE` / 文献表对网格的真复用 |

数据流总览：

```
脚本: #grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), ...) / #table(...)
  │  GridElem::synthesize / TableElem::synthesize      (typst-library)
  ▼
CellGrid ── 轨道(含 gutter 交织) + Entry(Cell/Merged) + hlines/vlines + headers/footer
  │  GRID_RULE / TABLE_RULE → BlockElem::multi_layouter (rules.rs)
  ▼
GridLayouter (typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs)
  │  measure_columns: 固定 → auto 试探测量 → fr 分红 / auto 公平收缩
  │  layout(): 逐行 layout_auto_row / layout_relative_row / Row::Fr
  ▼
Fragment (多页时含重复表头/跨页 rowspan)

脚本: $ a/b + sqrt(x) $   (EquationElem)
  │  resolve_equation (typst-library/src/math/ir)
  ▼
MathItem 树 (MathKind::Fraction / Radical / Glyph / Table / ...)
  │  MathContext::layout_into_self 递归 + layout_realized 按 kind 派发
  ▼
MathFragment 流 → MathRun 行装配(row_into_line_frame / stack_rows) → Frame
```

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 模块一：网格轨道模型——从 `TrackSizings` 到 `CellGrid`

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

**轨道（track）** 是网格里一整列（或一整行）的尺寸单位，概念借自 CSS Grid。用户在脚本里写的 `columns: (60pt, 1fr, 2fr)` 就是一个轨道列表，每个轨道是三种尺寸之一：

- `auto`：按内容自适应——把这一列所有单元格各排一遍，取最宽的；
- 固定或相对长度（`10pt`、`20% - 1cm`）：确切大小；
- `1fr`：所有其他轨道定下来之后，按分数瓜分剩余空间。

`grid` 与 `table` 在 Typst 里是**两个语义不同的元素**（无障碍、样式互不影响），但在布局引擎层面**完全是同一台机器**：二者在 Synthesize 阶段都被编译成同一个内部结构 `CellGrid`，再交给同一个 `GridLayouter`。这是「一个通用引擎 + 多个语义外壳」的典型架构。

`CellGrid` 解决的核心问题有三个：

1. **轨道统一**：把用户给的列/行轨道与 gutter（列间距/行间距）轨道交织成一条统一的轨道序列，之后布局器不必再区分「内容轨道」和「间距轨道」；
2. **定位与合并**：单元格支持 `x`/`y` 手工定位和 `colspan`/`rowspan` 跨行列，被跨过的位置要标记为「已合并」，指向真正的父单元格；
3. **附属物收集**：`hline`/`vline` 线条、可跨页重复的表头（header）与表脚（footer）也被收进同一结构。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

从脚本到布局的完整链路：

```
GridElem / TableElem（脚本参数：columns/rows/gutter/inset/align/fill/stroke + children）
   │  Synthesize::synthesize
   │     grid_to_cellgrid(...) / table_to_cellgrid(...)
   ▼
CellGrid {
     cols/rows: Vec<Sizing>   ← 内容轨道与 gutter 轨道交织后的统一序列
     entries: Vec<Entry>      ← Entry::Cell(Cell) | Entry::Merged { parent }
     vlines / hlines          ← 显式线条
     headers / footer         ← 可重复表头表脚
 }
   │  realize 阶段: GRID_RULE / TABLE_RULE
   │     → BlockElem::multi_layouter(elem, crate::grid::layout_grid / layout_table)
   ▼
GridLayouter::new(grid, regions, ...).layout(engine)   （模块二的主角）
```

gutter 交织的规则（以 2 列 + gutter 为例）：`[列0, gutter, 列1, gutter, 列2, ...]`，最后一条多余的 gutter 会被 `pop` 掉。于是**偶数下标是内容轨道，奇数下标是 gutter 轨道**。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

先看轨道尺寸的类型定义。`Sizing` 是一个三变体枚举，住在 typst-library：

[`Sizing` 枚举定义](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/container.rs#L476-L485)——`Auto`、`Rel(Rel)`、`Fr(Fr)` 三种轨道形态，并提供 `is_auto()` / `is_fractional()` 谓词。用户脚本能写的所有轨道尺寸最终都归约到这三个变体。

脚本参数到轨道列表的转换由 `TrackSizings` 完成：

[`TrackSizings` 与其 cast 规则](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L453-L463)——这段代码实现了文档里的便捷写法：单个 `Sizing` 变单轨道；非零整数 `3` 展开成 `(auto, auto, auto)`（`smallvec![Sizing::Auto; count.get()]`）；数组逐项 cast。所以 `columns: 5` 与 `columns: (auto, auto, auto, auto, auto)` 等价。

`GridElem` 把这些参数声明为字段：

[`GridElem` 的 columns/rows/gutter 字段](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L183-L221)——注意 `gutter` 是 `#[external]` 的语法糖：真正的字段是 `column_gutter` 与 `row_gutter`，二者的 `#[parse]` 属性先找各自的命名参数、找不到就回落到 `gutter`。单元格的跨行列能力则在 `GridCell` 上：

[`GridCell` 的 x/y/colspan/rowspan 字段](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L804-L840)——`x`/`y` 支持手工定位（`Smart<usize>`，`auto` 表示顺流自动放置），`colspan`/`rowspan` 默认为 1，这就是「跨两列单元格」在数据层的样子。

关键的一步发生在 Synthesize：

[`GridElem` 的 Synthesize 实现](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L441-L451)——`grid_to_cellgrid(self, engine, styles)?` 把元素编译成 `CellGrid`，存进内部合成字段 `grid: Arc<CellGrid>`（[L411-L413](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/mod.rs#L411-L420)）。布局阶段只需 `elem.grid.as_ref().unwrap()` 就能拿到现成结构，Synthesize 与 Layout 的分界正在这里。

[`grid_to_cellgrid` 的实现](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L27-L74)——把 columns/rows/gutter/inset/align/fill/stroke 逐个取出，children（Header/Footer/Item）映射成 `ResolvableGridChild`，最终交给通用的 `resolve_cellgrid`。`table` 那边几乎是逐行对称的代码：

[`TableElem` 的 Synthesize](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/model/table.rs#L310-L320) 调用 [`table_to_cellgrid`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L78-L125)——两个函数体只有类型名不同。这就是「table 与 grid 共用引擎」在源码层的直接证据。

解析产物 `CellGrid` 的结构：

[`CellGrid` 结构定义](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L654-L677)——`entries` 是行优先的一维数组，`cols`/`rows` 是**含 gutter 轨道**的统一轨道序列，`vlines`/`hlines` 收显式线条，`headers`/`footer` 支撑跨页重复。每个位置上是：

[`Entry` 枚举：Cell 或 Merged](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L625-L645)——被 colspan/rowspan 覆盖的位置不是空，而是 `Entry::Merged { parent }`，指向父单元格的下标；`parent_cell_position`（[L793-L803](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L786-L803)）负责把合并位置映射回父位置。布局器测量列宽时靠它避免重复测量同一个跨行列单元格。

gutter 交织发生在构造函数里：

[`CellGrid::new_internal` 的轨道交织](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L700-L742)——每个内容轨道后面 push 一条 gutter 轨道（`get_or` 让 gutter 列表循环复用、不足时补零），最后 `pop` 掉多余的最后一条。行数取「用户给的行数」与「按单元格数量推算的行数」的较大值（L708-L713），所以 `columns: 4` 时给 12 个单元格会自动长出 3 行。

因为交织，访问 `(x, y)` 位置的坐标换算带了奇偶判断：

[`CellGrid::entry` 的奇偶寻址](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/grid/resolve.rs#L756-L776)——有 gutter 时偶数下标是内容、奇数下标是 gutter（返回 `None`），一维下标换算 `(y / 2) * c + x / 2`。

最后看布局侧的接线。realize 阶段的内置规则把两个元素接到同一个模块：

[`GRID_RULE` 与 `TABLE_RULE`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/rules.rs#L538-L540)——`TABLE_RULE` 把 `TableElem` 包成携带 `crate::grid::layout_table` 回调的 `BlockElem::multi_layouter`（`GRID_RULE` 在 [L698-L700](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/rules.rs#L698-L700) 对称地接 `layout_grid`）。这正是 u4-l2 讲过的 `NativeRuleMap` 机制：元素不变，行为经函数指针注入。

[`layout_grid` 与 `layout_table` 入口](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/mod.rs#L98-L122)——两个函数都是三行：取出 Synthesize 阶段存好的 `CellGrid`，`GridLayouter::new(grid, regions, locator, styles, span).layout(engine)`。区别只在元素类型，引擎零差异。

顺带一提，同文件里的 [`layout_cell`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/mod.rs#L30-L62) 是网格递归布局的最内层：任何单元格最终都回到 `crate::layout_fragment` 通用入口，还会为 table/grid 单元格手工生成 introspection 标签（与 u4-l7 的内省机制相接）。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`columns: 3` 和 `columns: (auto,)` 分别展开成什么？

> **答案**：`columns: 3` 经 `TrackSizings` 的 `NonZeroUsize` 分支展开为 `(auto, auto, auto)`；`columns: (auto,)` 就是单条 auto 轨道。注意文档特别说明：对 columns 而言单个值只会产生**一列**，这与 rows/gutter「单值循环复用」的行为不同（`get_or` 的循环复用只发生在 gutter 与超出给定长度的 rows 上）。

**练习 2**：为什么 `GridElem` 要在 Synthesize 阶段就把脚本参数编译成 `CellGrid`，而不是留到布局函数里现算？

> **答案**：`CellGrid` 存进 `Arc<CellGrid>` 合成字段后成为元素状态的一部分：(1) 布局函数签名极简（`layout_grid` 只需 unwrap 一下）；(2) 定位冲突、colspan 越界这类**求值期错误**能在 Synthesize 里以正确的 span 报给用户，而不是等布局时才炸；(3) 结构可哈希、可复用，对 comemo 增量编译友好（u5-l8 会展开）。

**练习 3**：2 列 + `column-gutter: 3pt` 的网格，统一轨道序列是什么？`entry(3, 2)` 返回什么？

> **答案**：序列为 `[列0, 3pt, 列1]`（最后的 gutter 被 pop）。`x = 3` 越界（共 3 条轨道，合法下标 0..2）；若问 `entry(1, 2)`——奇数 x 是 gutter 位置，返回 `None`。

### 4.2 模块二：轨道尺寸协商——`measure_columns` 的三方谈判

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

网格最核心的问题是：**每条轨道到底多宽？** Typst 的答案是一场固定次序的「三方谈判」：

1. **固定轨道**（`Rel`）先行：相对基准宽度解析成绝对值，占用从不动摇；
2. **`auto` 轨道**其次：把这一列的每个单元格用试探 region 排一遍，取最大自然宽度——这就是 CSS 里的 max-content 测量；
3. **`fr` 轨道**最后：若还有剩余空间，按分数比例瓜分（`1fr` 与 `3fr` 按 1:3 分）；若 `auto` 们已经把空间吃超了，则反过来让超标的 `auto` 轨道「公平收缩」到同一宽度。

行方向（`rows`）用同一套 `Sizing` 语义，但多了两个变数：`auto` 行可能**跨区域断开**（长单元格跨页续排），`fr` 行只是先登记、等区域收尾时才知道自己分到多高。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

列方向协商的伪代码（对应 `measure_columns`）：

```
rel = Σ 固定轨道解析值        # 先解析所有 Rel 列
fr  = Σ fr 轨道的份数
available = region宽度 − rel

if available ≥ 0:
    (auto, count) = measure_auto_columns(available)   # 试探布局取最大
    remaining = available − auto
    if remaining ≥ 0:
        grow_fractional_columns(remaining, fr)        # fr 按比例分红
    else:
        shrink_auto_columns(available, count)         # auto 公平收缩
```

fr 分红公式（`Fr::share`）：

\[ w_i = \frac{f_i}{\sum_j f_j} \cdot \max(\text{remaining},\ 0) \]

auto 公平收缩（`shrink_auto_columns`）是一个迭代剔除过程：反复计算 `fair = redistribute / overlarge`，把「不超标」（`rcol ≤ fair`）的 auto 列移出待分集合、把它们占用的宽度还给公共池，直到集合不再变化；最后所有仍超标的列统一压到 `fair`。这保证**收缩负担只落在确实过宽的列上**，窄列不受牵连。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

主入口：

[`measure_columns`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L914-L957)——先扫一遍所有列：`Sizing::Rel(v)` 解析进 `rel`（`v.resolve(styles).relative_to(self.regions.base().x)`），`Sizing::Fr(v)` 累进 `fr`；然后 `available = regions.size.x − rel`，按剩余空间走向 `measure_auto_columns` → `grow_fractional_columns` 或 `shrink_auto_columns`。整个函数 40 行出头，是「谈判议程表」本身。

auto 测量是网格里最精巧的部分：

[`measure_auto_columns` 主体](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L985-L1099)——对每个 auto 列，遍历该列所有行：经 `parent_cell_position` 找到父单元格（跳过合并位置与已测过的 rowspan，L991-L999）；构造试探 pod `Region::new(Size::new(available, height), Axes::splat(false))` 调 `layout_cell` 真排一遍，`resolved.set_max(frame.width() - already_covered_width)` 取最大值。`already_covered_width`（[L1076](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L1076)）减去跨列单元格已从**先前解析的列**那里获得的宽度——一个跨 3 列的宽单元格不应把 3 列都撑到自己的全宽。

跨列单元格还有两条专门规则：

[colspan 只影响最后一条 auto 列 + 全 fr 列启发式](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L1001-L1036)——(1) 跨列单元格只把自己「多出来的宽度」记到它所跨的**最后一条** auto 列头上（其余位置 `continue`）；(2) 若单元格已经跨过了网格里**全部** fr 列且区域宽度有限，则干脆不撑宽 auto 列——fr 列分红后自然会腾出空间给它。这两条规则对应的测试就在 [`colspan.typ` 的 grid-colspan-over-all-fr-columns 等用例](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/tests/suite/layout/grid/colspan.typ#L92-L116)。

fr 分红：

[`grow_fractional_columns` 与 `Fr::share`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L1101-L1112)——每条 fr 列分得 `v.share(fr, remaining)`，[`share` 的实现](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/layout/fr.rs#L56-L63) 就是上面的比例公式，`remaining.max(Abs::zero())` 保证负余量不分倒扣。

公平收缩：

[`shrink_auto_columns`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L1114-L1145)——`while changed && overlarge > 0` 循环不断剔除不需要收缩的列并重算 `fair`，末尾把所有 `rcol > fair` 的 auto 列钳到 `fair`。注释原文「Redistribute space to auto columns so that each gets a fair share」正是文档里「auto 轨道公平分配可用空间」承诺的落点。

行方向的派发在主循环里：

[`layout_row_internal` 按行轨道类型派发](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L425-L464)——`Sizing::Auto` 走 `layout_auto_row`（先测量后正式布局，可跨区域断开续排）、`Sizing::Rel` 走 `layout_relative_row`、`Sizing::Fr` 只是把 `Row::Fr(v, y, disambiguator)` 压进当前区域（[L452-L457](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L446-L458)），等 `finish_region` 收尾时才知道实际高度——与 u4-l4 里 flow 对 `fr` 间距的处理如出一辙。`Row` 枚举（[L214-L224](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L214-L224)）因此分 `Frame`（已完成的行）与 `Fr`（待分红的行）两态。

整场谈判的调度者是 [`GridLayouter::layout` 主循环](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/grid/layouter.rs#L313-L388)：先 `measure_columns` 定列宽，再处理重复表脚预留、逐行推进（跳过表头区间、遇到 footer 布局表脚）、收尾区域、补排遗漏的 rowspan，最后 `render_fills_strokes` 补线与背景。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：手工推算一张混合轨道表格的列宽，再用现成测试验证推算。

现成测试 [`grid-columns-sizings-rect`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/tests/suite/layout/grid/grid.typ#L3-L20) 用了 `#set page(width: 100pt)` 与 `columns: (auto, 1fr, 3fr, 0.25cm, 3%, 2mm + 10%)`，auto 列两个单元格分别宽 `0.5cm` 与 `1cm`。

按 `measure_columns` 的议程手算（换算 \(1\,\text{cm} = 72/2.54 \approx 28.35\,\text{pt}\)，\(2\,\text{mm} \approx 5.67\,\text{pt}\)，百分比基准 = 页宽 100pt）：

\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{rel} &= 7.09 + 3 + (5.67 + 10) = 25.76\,\text{pt} \\
\text{available} &= 100 - 25.76 = 74.24\,\text{pt} \\
\text{auto} &= \max(14.17,\ 28.35) = 28.35\,\text{pt} \\
\text{remaining} &= 74.24 - 28.35 = 45.89\,\text{pt} \\
1\text{fr} &= 45.89 \times \tfrac{1}{4} \approx 11.47\,\text{pt},\quad 3\text{fr} \approx 34.42\,\text{pt}
\end{aligned}
\]

操作步骤：

1. 先写下你自己的推算结果；
2. 运行 `cargo testit grid-columns-sizings-rect` 确认测试通过；
3. 把该用例复制到 `sizing-practice.typ`，在网格外面加一行 `#context grid.cell` 不行——更直接的办法：给每列套 `rect(width: 100%)` 已经是这个测试的做法，观察渲染图中各色块的实际宽度比例是否与推算一致（1fr 块 : 3fr 块 ≈ 1 : 3，且 auto 列宽等于 1cm 的那块）；
4. 再做反向实验：把列改成 `columns: (auto, auto)`、页宽保持 100pt，两个单元格各塞一段 80pt 宽的文本，触发 `shrink_auto_columns`——观察两列是否被压到接近 50pt 的公平宽度。

**需要观察的现象**：fr 列宽度严格按 1:3 分红；auto 超载时两条 auto 列收缩后近似等宽。

**预期结果**：推算值与渲染宽度吻合（±四舍五入误差）。具体像素值待本地验证。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`columns: (60pt, 1fr)`、页宽 100pt、只有一个空单元格，1fr 列多宽？

> **答案**：rel = 60pt，available = 40pt；auto 列不存在，auto 总量为 0；remaining = 40pt ≥ 0，唯一 fr 列分得全部 40pt。（`Fr::share` 中 \(1/1 \times 40 = 40\)。）

**练习 2**：三个 auto 列测量出 50pt、30pt、20pt，available 只有 60pt，最终各多宽？

> **答案**：`shrink_auto_columns`：初算 fair = 60/3 = 20pt，20pt 的列不超标被剔除（还给池子 20pt），剩 2 列分 40pt → fair = 20pt，30 与 50 仍超标、无新剔除，循环稳定；最终两列压到 20pt，原 20pt 列不变——结果 (20pt, 20pt, 20pt)。注意这个算法下「恰好等于 fair」的列不再参与挤压。

**练习 3**：为什么 `fr` 行不能像 `Rel` 行那样当场布局？

> **答案**：`fr` 的语义是「其他轨道分完之后的剩余空间」，而网格可能跨多个区域（页）：必须等当前区域里所有固定/自动行都排完、`finish_region` 时才知道剩余高度，才能给 `Row::Fr` 定高。这正是 `Row::Fr` 只登记不布局、推迟到收尾的原因（与 u4-l4 中 flow 对 fr 间距的延迟处理同构）。

### 4.3 模块三：列表复用——一段架构演进史

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

大纲给本模块起名「列表项复用网格的方式」。**这个说法描述的是历史版本，而当前 HEAD 已经不是这样了**——这本身就是极好的架构课：

- **旧设计（≈ 2026 年 5 月之前）**：`lists.rs` 里 `layout_list`/`layout_enum` 亲手构造一个两列 `CellGrid`（marker 列 + body 列），交给 `GridLayouter` 布局。列表 = 一种特殊的网格，复用整套 auto 轨道测量与跨页协商。
- **现设计**：提交 `b241417c4`（*Improved list layout (#7895)*，2026-05-27）重写为专用的 `ListLayouter` + `ItemLayouter`，每一项经 `StackLayoutChild::CustomLayouter` 回调交给**栈布局**（`layout_stack_internal`）。

替换的直接动机是**基线对齐**：用户要求列表 marker（如 `1.`、`a)`）与正文第一行基线对齐（`number-align` / `marker-align`）。网格的行模型以「行框」为单位，表达不了「把 marker 下移 x pt，或把 body 重新排版并下移」这种非对称微调（见 4.3.3 的 `baseline_align`），于是列表走上了专用路径。

「复用网格」今天依然存在，只是搬了家：**文献目录（bibliography）**在 realize 阶段真的构造一个 `GridElem` 来排两栏文献条目；**table** 更是整个复用网格引擎（本讲 4.1）。所以准确的结论是：*通用引擎负责真正二维的场合，二维性很弱（两列、基线驱动）的列表退回专用实现。*

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

当前 `layout_items` 的四步流程（源码 doc comment 原文总结）：

```
1. measure_markers   —— 逐项试探布局 marker，取最大宽度（marker_width）
                        （这就是「auto 轨道测量」的迷你版！）
2. measure_bodies    —— 仅当区域宽度无限或 width: auto 时，测 body 最大宽度，
                        让各项在彼此之间对齐而不是对齐页宽
3. layout_item       —— 每项一个 ItemLayouter：排 marker、排 body、
                        基线对齐（或显式垂直对齐）
4. layout_stack_internal —— 各项作为 StackLayoutChild::CustomLayouter
                        交给栈布局器纵向堆叠（间距 = spacing/tight 逻辑）
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

先用 git 考古确认「前世」：

```bash
git show b241417c4~1:crates/typst-layout/src/lists.rs | grep -n "CellGrid\|GridLayouter"

# 13:use crate::grid::GridLayouter;
# 56:    let grid = CellGrid::new(
# 66:    let layouter = GridLayouter::new(&grid, regions, locator, styles, elem.span());
```

旧版 `layout_list` 在第 56 行构造 `CellGrid::new`（两列：marker 与 body），第 66 行交给 `GridLayouter`——「列表复用网格」的出处。对比当前文件 [`lists.rs` 的 import 区](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/lists.rs#L1-L16)：只剩 `layout_stack_internal`，网格的痕迹完全消失。

现在的入口：

[`layout_list`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/lists.rs#L18-L76)——取出 `indent`/`body_indent`/`tight`/`spacing`（tight 列表默认用段落 `leading`，宽列表用段落 `spacing`，L30-L32）；解析 marker 并 `aligned(marker_align)`；把每项 body 包上 `PdfMarkerTag::ListItemLabel/ListItemBody`（无障碍语义）；最后组装 `ListLayouter` 进入 `layout_items`。`layout_enum`（[L80-L171](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/lists.rs#L80-L171)）只多出编号计算（`numbering.apply`、`reversed` 递减），后半段完全共享。

离开网格的理由——基线对齐：

[`ItemLayouter::baseline_align`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/lists.rs#L509-L557)——计算 `diff = body首帧基线 − marker基线`：`diff ≥ 0` 时把 marker 下移 `diff`（L534-L537）；`diff < 0` 时反过来**用更小的空间重排 body** 再下移（L549-L554）——「重新排版子内容并平移」这种操作超出了网格行模型的表达力，这是重写的核心动机。之后 [`finish`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/lists.rs#L586-L634) 把 marker 放进第一个非空帧、body 整体缩进（RTL 时镜像处理，L604-L625）。

栈布局侧的配合改造：

[`StackLayoutChild::CustomLayouter` 与 `layout_stack_internal`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/stack.rs#L33-L40)——为这次重写专门加的变体：允许每个 child 自带布局回调（注释明说「useful when using stack layout to create other layouters, such as that of lists」），使列表项能借用栈的间距/分页协商而保留自定义内部布局。

复用网格的「现任」：

[`BIBLIOGRAPHY_RULE` 中手工构造 GridElem](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/rules.rs#L479-L505)——带编号前缀的文献表把（前缀, 条目）装进 `GridChild::Item(GridItem::Cell(...))`，构造 `GridElem::new(cells).with_columns(TrackSizings(smallvec![Sizing::Auto; 2]))`（两条 auto 列）加 gutter，`synthesize` 后直接包成 `BlockElem::multi_layouter(packed, crate::grid::layout_grid)`。这就是今天「XX 复用网格」的标准写法。列表的接线则在 [`LIST_RULE`](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-layout/src/rules.rs#L123-L140)：`BlockElem::multi_layouter(elem, crate::lists::layout_list)`，tight 时在前面补一个弱 `v` 间距。
